chemistry-h3-q2.title: Kuvavanyo lwezantya zokuqala lwentsabela
chemistry-h3-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h3-q2.material: Kuvavanyo lwezantya zokuqala lwentsabela 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), xa [O₂] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [NO] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-4, kwaye xa [NO] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [O₂] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-2. Yintoni umthetho wesantya kunye ne-overall reaction order yale ntsabela?
chemistry-h3-q2.s.s1.prompt: Kuvavanyo lwezantya zokuqala lwentsabela 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), xa [O₂] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [NO] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-4, kwaye xa [NO] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [O₂] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-2. Yintoni umthetho wesantya kunye ne-overall reaction order yale ntsabela?
chemistry-h3-q2.s.s1.explain: Xa $[\text{NO}]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$4$, ngoko $m=2$, kwaye xa $[\text{O}_2]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$2$, ngoko $n=1$. Umthetho wesantya yi-$v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, kwaye i-overall reaction order yi-$2 + 1 = 3$.
chemistry-h3-q2.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-h3-q2.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

chemistry-h3-q3.title: Intsabela ye-exothermic yegesi elandelayo
chemistry-h3-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h3-q3.material: Intsabela ye-exothermic yegesi elandelayo ikwi-dynamic equilibrium kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + ubushushu (ΔH < 0).  Zeziphi iimeko ekufuneka zilungiswe ukwandisa isivuno se-ammonia (NH₃) kwi-equilibrium?
chemistry-h3-q3.s.s1.prompt: Intsabela ye-exothermic yegesi elandelayo ikwi-dynamic equilibrium kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + ubushushu (ΔH < 0).  Zeziphi iimeko ekufuneka zilungiswe ukwandisa isivuno se-ammonia (NH₃) kwi-equilibrium?
chemistry-h3-q3.s.s1.explain: Kuba intsabela i-exothermic ($\Delta H < 0$), ubushushu kufuneka buhliswe ukuze intsabela ebheke phambili, ekhupha ubushushu, ibe ngaphezulu. Kwakhona, kuba iimoli zegesi zehla zisuka ku-$4\text{ mol} \rightarrow 2\text{ mol}$, uxinzelelo kufuneka lunyuswe ukuze i-equilibrium ibhekise kwintsabela ebheke phambili, ehlisa inani leemolekyuli.

chemistry-h3-c.title: [Iimpawu ze-colligative ezi-advanced zezisombululo]
chemistry-h3-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h3-c.material: [Iimpawu ze-colligative ezi-advanced zezisombululo] Sesiphi isikhetho esiqulathe zonke kuphela izitatimenti ezichanekileyo ngeempawu (colligative properties) zesisombululo esifakwe amanzi esine-solute engatshabalaliyo, engekho-electrolyte? (i) Zilingana kuphela nenani lezinto ezincinci ze-solute (molality), nokuba luhlobo luni lwe-solute. (ii) Uxinzelelo lomphunga luyehla kwaye indawo yokubila iyanyuka xa kuthelekiswa ne-solvent ecocekileyo. (iii) Ifomula ye-osmotic pressure ka-van 't Hoff, Π = cRT, ifana ne-ideal gas equation of state.

(iii) Ifomula ye-osmotic pressure ka-van 't Hoff, Π = cRT, ifana ne-ideal gas equation of state.
chemistry-h3-c.s.s1.explain: Iimpawu ze-colligative zesisombululo zixhomekeke kuphela kwinani lezinto ezincinci, nokuba luhlobo luni lwe-solute, kwaye zibandakanya ukwehla koxinzelelo lomphunga, ukunyuka kwendawo yokubila, ukwehla kwendawo yokukhenkceza, kunye ne-osmotic pressure ($\Pi = cRT$), ngoko (i), (ii), kunye ne-(iii) zonke zichanekile.

chemistry-killer-12.title: Kwi-25 °C i-$\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ ye-acetic
chemistry-killer-12.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-12.material: Kwi-25 °C i-$\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ ye-acetic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a = 4.7$) yi-4.7. I-buffer yenziwa ngokuxuba i-100 mL ye-0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ ne-100 mL ye-0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$. Emva koko i-10 mL ye-1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ iyongezwa. Yintoni i-pH yesisombululo? (Utshintsho lokuxinana ngenxa yotshintsho lomthamo alunchaphazeli ukubala komlinganiselo; sebenzisa i-$\log 2 = 0.30$. I-NaOH isabela ngokupheleleyo ne-acetic acid.)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: Kwi-25 °C i-$\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ ye-acetic acid ($\mathrm{p}K_a = 4.7$) yi-4.7. I-buffer yenziwa ngokuxuba i-100 mL ye-0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ ne-100 mL ye-0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$. Emva koko i-10 mL ye-1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ iyongezwa. Yintoni i-pH yesisombululo? (Utshintsho lokuxinana ngenxa yotshintsho lomthamo alunchaphazeli ukubala komlinganiselo; sebenzisa i-$\log 2 = 0.30$. I-NaOH isabela ngokupheleleyo ne-acetic acid.)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Iimoli zokuqala: HA = 20 mmol, A⁻ = 10 mmol (i-pH yokuqala = 4.7 + log 0.5 = 4.7 - 0.30 = 4.4).
Inyathelo 2: NaOH = 1.0 M x 10 mL = 10 mmol. Kwi-$\mathrm{OH^- + HA \rightarrow A^- + H_2O}$, i-HA iyehla nge-10 mmol kwaye i-A⁻ iyanda nge-10 mmol: HA = 10 mmol, A⁻ = 20 mmol.
Inyathelo 3: Zombini zikwisisombululo esinye, ngoko umlinganiselo wokuxinana ulingana nomlinganiselo weemoli = 2. pH = 4.7 + log 2 = 4.7 + 0.30 = 5.0.
Iimpendulo: 5.0 (d). (Ezinye ezingachanekanga: i-4.4 yi-pH ngaphambi kokongezwa kwe-NaOH; i-4.7 ithatha ngephutha i-HA = A⁻; i-5.3 isebenzisa umlinganiselo we-4.)
